expected: The browser can complete the password-reset flow in contract order: request an email code (204), verify the six-digit code and receive a server-issued resetToken (200), then confirm the new password with that token (204), without creating an authenticated session.
actual: The final auth-session.spec.ts browser suite passed 10/10. The password-reset case observed POST /auth/password-reset/request with {email} and a fixture 204; POST /auth/password-reset/verify with {email, code} and a fixture 200 containing resetToken; and POST /auth/password-reset/confirm with {email, resetToken, newPassword} and a fixture 204. The success state was visible and auth-sign-out remained absent. All tested e2e.test endpoints used Playwright route fixtures; no backend request was made.
